name: PreserveTube
description: PreserveTube is a time capsule for YouTube videos! It allows you to preserve any YouTube video, creating a snapshot that will always be available even if the original video disappears or is taken down.
author: Freeb

captcha.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/131.0.6778.200 Mobile Safari/537.36

settings.name: Enable YouTube Channel Separation
settings.description: When enabled, YouTube channel URLs will be treated as PreserveTube channels with separated IDs (prefixed with 'preservetube://') to avoid conflicts with the YouTube plugin. Disable to keep YouTube channel URLs pointing to the YouTube plugin instead.

settings.name: Enable Archiving to PreserveTube
settings.description: When enabled, unarchived YouTube videos will prompt you to archive them on PreserveTube via captcha. Disabled by default so unarchived videos open in the YouTube plugin instead.
settings.warningDialog: By enabling this, you agree to only use this feature for videos that you genuinely believe should be preserved long term.
